roteiro.toAudioHelp: Copy the script and paste it into Generate Audio to hear it in your cloned voice.

roteiro.chatHelp: Ask for changes in plain words: "make it shorter", "open from another angle", "drop the middle part". Each message uses credits.
roteiro.chatPlaceholder: What do you want to change in the script?

sgp.subtitulo: Fill in each step carefully. Our team will use this information to build your clone.

dados.descricao: We need your details to set up your clone. All information is kept strictly confidential.
dados.dicaCodigo: We'll email you a 6-digit code. You are NOT creating an account yet: the platform sign-up happens at the end, after the review.
dados.codigoEnviado: We sent a code to your email. Check your inbox (and spam).
dados.codigoEnviadoContaExistente: This email already has a FastCloner account. We sent a code to confirm it's yours — at the end we attach everything to your account.
dados.codigoInvalido: Invalid or expired code. Check and try again.
dados.whatsappInvalido: Enter a valid WhatsApp number with area code.

foto.descricao: Upload high-quality photos to be the base of your clone. Download the guide below to see exactly how to take the ideal photo.
foto.guiaDescricao: Detailed instructions for the ideal clone photo

ciencia.luz: Good lighting (front light, no shadows on the face)
ciencia.enquadramento: Framed from the chest up, looking at the camera
ciencia.sem_acessorios: No sunglasses, hat or accessories covering the face

foto.fotosDica: Any photo format works (JPG, PNG, iPhone HEIC, WEBP…). Upload {min} to {max} photos of yourself at once: face and body. You need at least one front and one side (profile or 3/4). We only reject images with no one in them or with other people.
foto.indeciso: We couldn't analyze it right now. Try uploading again.

audio.descricao: Record at least 20 minutes of audio to clone your voice with high fidelity. Reading or natural speech both work.
audio.videoPendente: ⚠️ Lucas's video explaining the recording goes here (pending recording).

ciencia.30min: I recorded at least 20 minutes of audio
ciencia.mesmo_ambiente: All blocks recorded in the same room
ciencia.fala_natural: Natural speech or reading (no whispering or shouting)

audio.arquivosDica: Upload one or more files (MP3, WAV, M4A, phone recording…). Minutes add up. The system checks each file: volume, noise, silence and language — only approved speech counts.
audio.indeciso: We couldn't analyze it right now. Try uploading again.
audio.arquivoLongo: This file is {tem} long — the limit is {max} min per file. Split it into smaller parts and upload again.

revisao.descricao: Review everything before sending. After confirmation, our team starts building your clone.
revisao.cienciaFoto: You confirmed {n} of 5 items from the photo guide.
revisao.cienciaAudio: You confirmed {n} of 4 items from the audio guide.
revisao.lgpdTexto: In accordance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (Law 13.709/2018), all personal data provided in this form will be used exclusively to set up your AI clone. Your data is kept strictly confidential, is not shared with third parties and is discarded after the service is complete. You can request deletion at any time by contacting our team.
revisao.declaracao: I declare the information sent is correct, I authorize the Ready Generation System team to use my data exclusively to set up my AI clone, and I agree to the data processing described above.
revisao.avisoProcessamento: When you send, the system starts building your clone (photo and voice). You can follow it on the next screen or close — we email you when each step is done.
revisao.acessoDescricao: We'll create your account with {email}. Choose a password:
revisao.acessoExistente: {email} already has a FastCloner account — we'll attach this material to it. After sending, sign in with your usual password.
